positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented a secure protocol to allow web browsers to connect directly to MemSQL and MySQL databases over websockets. Built a managed solution for running MemSQL on AWS, GCP, and Azure with automated backups, rolling upgrades, and data redundancy.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built MemSQL Streamliner, leveraging Apache Spark to ingest real-time data into a MemSQL in-memory database. Developed tools for installation, configuration, and management of the MemSQL distributed system.

positions.title: Graduate Student Instructor
positions.description: Organized and developed curriculum and labs for introductory class in signal processing (EE20N), and led discussions along with software labs for groups of 20-30 students.

positions.description: Honors Program in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science.
